title: simpledeathmessages
description: Fully customizable death message system with clors, emojis, and 24+ death types
body:
# SimpleDeathMessages

**SimpleDeathMessage is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that enhances your Minecraft server by replacing default death messages with fully customizable ones.**

**With 24+ unique death messages, this plugin covers a wide range of scenarios including PvP, natural causes, environmental damage, mob kills, and more. Each message can be personalized using Minecraft color codes and even emojis to make deaths more fun and engaging for players.**

## Features

- ✔️ **24+ custom death messages**
- ✔️ **Covers PvP, mobs, environment, and natural deaths**
- ✔️ **Fully configurable in a simple config file**
- ✔️ **Supports Minecraft color codes (& formatting)**
- ✔️ **Emoji support for extra style 😄**
- ✔️ **Option to enable or disable a global death message**
- ✔️ **Lightweight and performance-friendly**
